name: Signal Matrix
pitch: A premium LED matrix where every metric is a lit dot.
tradeoff: The strict grid spends its space on black, so names stay short and detail waits on hover.
fontWhy: Doto is a designed dot-matrix face for the big numerals, and Martian Mono keeps 12px labels and changing figures tabular.
logoIdea: An R of dots on one path, lighting in order like a run leaving its trace.
sliderIdea: A 35-lamp step sequencer, one lamp per day, bright inside the selected window.
signatureMotion: A scan sweeps the matrix, and dots flip on in a wave when the window changes.
